caption: `docker compose up` starts the gateway, 2 payment nodes, account service, 2 workers, bank mock, PostgreSQL and Redis - every container healthy
Health check endpoint: the gateway polls each node's /health and reports status, circuit breaker, and queue depth per node
GET /health (JSON): overall status UP / DEGRADED / DOWN, rate-limiter backend and per-node details
Gateway routing table: /api/v1/payments -> payment-service (2 nodes, round robin), /api/v1/accounts and /api/v1/vpa -> account-service

Token-bucket rate limiter: one client floods 80 requests; requests pass while its bucket has tokens (burst 40, refilling 20/s), the rest get 429 Too Many Requests with Retry-After, while another client is unaffected
End-to-end smoke test: health, routing, cache HIT, async payment, idempotency, 400 without Idempotency-Key, bank decline, 404 route, 429 burst, /stats - all 11 checks pass
Database tables created by the migration scripts (db/migrations/001-003)
Schema of the transactions table: unique idempotency_key, status enum, lease columns, request_id for tracing, CHECK payer <> payee
Migration runner: every SQL file applied once and recorded in schema_migrations
Worker results in PostgreSQL: transaction status, one debit + one credit ledger row per SUCCESS, totals by status
Append-only audit log: PENDING (payment service) -> PROCESSING -> SUCCESS (worker) for one payment
Redis cache: the first balance read is a MISS (PostgreSQL), the second a HIT from Redis - faster
Redis holds the payment stream + consumer group (async queue), cache entries with TTLs, and the token buckets of the rate limiter
Asynchronous processing: POST returns 202 at once, the second request with the same Idempotency-Key is replayed (no second debit), the worker moves it PENDING -> SUCCESS
Structured logging: one request id followed Gateway -> payment service -> Redis Stream -> worker -> bank -> PostgreSQL
Metrics: requests, 429s by scope, cache hit ratio, DB queries, settled payments, retries and circuit-breaker openings per node (from GET /stats)
Automated tests: token bucket, Lua script, circuit breaker, retry/backoff, gateway proxy, worker settlement logic, dashboard and Pay Console routes - all pass
Locust load-test report - 100 concurrent users (60 s): request statistics per endpoint, failures (429) and response-time percentiles
